groups.title: Scopes
principles: First type of scope is the operation. It's first base-2 or base-4 number compatible information bit at special position.

Second and third types are even and odd, R and T distribution of two closest ranks; compatible system might need it to be in reverse when choosing even and odd differently in two cases for 1st and 2nd position of it's subarray.

items.meaning: Sign is half (b2) or one quarter (b4) of directional encoding; for example + and - are two directions; heart is symbol of how starting from neutral zero, one can follow the mean or divide the axe to two infinities.
Circle at second octave is topologically most similar to square; square thus means even octave or two-channel content.
Circle is the normal reach of a scalar - if squares are even, this is odd; if square is two-channel - this is one.
